installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ATIVE UAS Bot Installation Script
# Node.js with Canvas, MySQL2, Discord.js v14 support + Git deployment

cd /mnt/server

echo "🔄 Updating package lists..."
apt update

echo "📦 Installing system dependencies for Canvas, MySQL, and Git..."
apt install -y \
    build-essential \
    libcairo2-dev \
    libpango1.0-dev \
    libjpeg-dev \
    libgif-dev \
    librsvg2-dev \
    libfontconfig1-dev \
    python3 \
    python3-pip \
    pkg-config \
    default-mysql-client \
    git \
    curl \
    wget

# Git Repository Handling
if [ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
    echo "🗂️ Cloning repository: ${GIT_REPO}"
    
    # Remove any existing files
    rm -rf /mnt/server/* /mnt/server/.[!.]* || true
    
    if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ] || [ "${GIT_BRANCH}" == "" ]; then
        echo "📥 Cloning default branch from ${GIT_REPO}"
        git clone ${GIT_REPO} /mnt/server
    else
        echo "📥 Cloning branch '${GIT_BRANCH}' from ${GIT_REPO}"
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_REPO} /mnt/server
    fi
    
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✅ Repository cloned successfully"
    else
        echo "❌ Failed to clone repository"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "ℹ️ No Git repository specified, using uploaded files"
fi

# Navigate to correct directory if UAS bot is in a subdirectory
if [ -d "uas" ]; then
    echo "📂 Found UAS bot in 'uas' subdirectory, moving files..."
    cp -r uas/* .
    rm -rf uas
fi

# Install Node.js dependencies
if [ -f package.json ]; then
    echo "📦 Installing Node.js dependencies from package.json..."
    npm install --production
    
    # Ensure critical dependencies are installed
    echo "🎨 Installing Canvas with native dependencies..."
    npm install canvas --build-from-source
    
    echo "🔧 Installing additional UAS bot dependencies..."
    npm install discord.js@^14.14.1 mysql2@^3.6.5 winston@^3.11.0 dotenv@^16.3.1 node-cron@^3.0.3 ms@^2.1.3
else
    echo "📝 No package.json found, creating basic UAS bot structure..."
    npm init -y --name="ative-uas-bot" --version="1.0.0" --main="index.js"
    
    echo "📦 Installing UAS bot dependencies..."
    npm install discord.js@^14.14.1 mysql2@^3.6.5 winston@^3.11.0 dotenv@^16.3.1 node-cron@^3.0.3 ms@^2.1.3 canvas --build-from-source
fi

# Create necessary directories
echo "📁 Creating required directories..."
mkdir -p logs scripts

# Set up environment template if .env doesn't exist
if [ ! -f .env ] && [ -f .env.example ]; then
    echo "⚙️ Creating .env from .env.example template"
    cp .env.example .env
fi

# Verify critical files exist
if [ ! -f index.js ]; then
    echo "⚠️ Warning: index.js not found - make sure your repository contains the UAS bot files"
fi

if [ ! -f scripts/deploy-commands.js ]; then
    echo "⚠️ Warning: scripts/deploy-commands.js not found - slash command deployment may fail"
fi

# Set proper permissions
echo "🔐 Setting proper permissions..."
chown -R container:container /mnt/server
chmod -R 755 /mnt/server

# Display installation summary
echo ""
echo "✅ ATIVE UAS Bot installation completed!"
echo "📊 Installation Summary:"
echo "   • Node.js dependencies: $([ -f package.json ] && echo 'Installed from package.json' || echo 'Basic setup created')"
echo "   • Canvas support: Installed with native compilation"
echo "   • Database support: MySQL2 ready"
echo "   • Discord.js v14: Ready for slash commands"
echo "   • Git repository: $([ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ] && echo "${GIT_REPO}" || echo 'None (using uploaded files)')"
echo ""
echo "🚀 Ready to start the UAS bot!"
echo "   Next: Configure your environment variables and start the server"
